nodes.label: Translation and Dubbing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Results cached per (video, language) pair so they are not reprocessed; TTS speed auto-stretched to fit frames.

nodes.label: edge-tts
nodes.rationale: No GPU and no model download required; trade-off is no voice cloning.

nodes.label: AI Translation & Dubbing Feature
nodes.rationale: Key differentiator, similar to Meta AI / Reels dubbing. Start with STT+translation+subtitles, then add TTS/dubbing.

nodes.label: Third-party AI APIs first, self-host later
nodes.norm_label: third-party ai apis first, self-host later

nodes.label: Upload fallback to POST /videos
nodes.rationale: Backend lacked /upload + SSE route; frontend falls back but video file is not sent.

nodes.label: BullMQ async job queue
nodes.rationale: Mandatory because transcode and AI dubbing are heavy; must not run synchronously in HTTP request.

nodes.label: Thin controllers (MVC)
nodes.rationale: Controllers only coordinate request/response and delegate logic to services.

nodes.label: RUN_WORKERS_IN_API setting
nodes.rationale: Set false to run worker as separate process via npm run worker.

nodes.label: Graceful degradation without AI service
nodes.rationale: Upload, feed and interactions work without AI service; only dubbing requests fail.

nodes.label: POST /tts
nodes.rationale: Segments longer than original window are sped up 0.75x-1.6x so dub does not drift from frames.

nodes.label: TikTak AI Service
nodes.rationale: Called by Node backend over HTTP; service does not access database.
